Behaviors/boundaries to test via `Parser.parse(String html, String baseUri)` and `parseBodyFragment`: 1. Basic well-formed HTML parses into correct DOM tree (html>head/body structure). 2. Self-closing/void tags (e.g., `
`, ``) don't swallow subsequent siblings. 3. Unclosed tags are auto-closed at EOF or at parent boundary (e.g., `

1

2` yields two sibling `

` elements). 4. Mismatched/stray end tags (e.g., `` with no matching open) are ignored without throwing. 5. Nested tags with improper close order correctly pop stack to nearest matching ancestor, not deeper/shallower. 6. Comments (``), CDATA, and XML declarations are parsed as distinct node types, not as text/elements. 7. Attributes with single quotes, double quotes, and unquoted values parse correctly; boolean attributes preserved. 8. Text nodes preserve whitespace/entities correctly and are not merged incorrectly with sibling elements. 9. `` and `<textarea>` content treated as raw text (no nested tag parsing inside them). 10. `parseBodyFragment` wraps fragment content inside `<body>` without requiring full `<html>`/`<head>` structure; empty/null input handled gracefully (empty Document, no exception).
